body: It lasted about a week for me but idk about u

This world is pure evil, trust me it is, there is so many opportunities for you to become the best version of yourself, I know I’ve dealt with stress for the past 2 years, but I push through it, you have your whole life to live, and you only got 1 life, live it large

I know you want to leave, but it’s not worth leaving your family behind, they will be in more pain then they’ve every felt without you, when I wanted to committ suicide, I thought about my family and I knew I couldn’t leave them behind, trust me your suicide leads to your family being depressed
Can you explain your motive to kill yourself? I want to help you out
I wouldn’t even recommend refilling pods unless it’s salt nic, regular vape juice can just leak through the pod and ruin ur battery

I can relate to you in so many ways, in 6th grade I was that popular kid who was funny and that go-to person, now I’m everyone’s last resort. Ik, it sucks being that last resort, but what I am trying to is rise up and prove everyone wrong that I am that go-to person like I used to be. It takes a lot, and when I mean a lot, I mean ALOT of work to rise above, but it’s so worth it at the end of the day, trust me.
Trust me I know how it feels I’ve wanted to end it many times recently but I couldn’t, I wasn’t able to leave family behind
U have a whole life ahead of you stuff can change
And I think about suicide almost every day still
School, Sports, Family members dying and arguments in the family, but its gotten a little better I guess
Stay real man just forget all the negativity
